sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ evidence shown does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans.
The bank’s retail loan policy says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
The UCB directions say that, in cases other than the listed exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

missing.searched: Searched the Gold Loan FAQ for any clause on pre-payment charge; the provided FAQ evidence only shows the document heading and the definition of a gold loan.
